sentences.text: Asiahesperornis was a flightless bird with teeth that propelled itself through water by moving its feet.
It belongs to the group Hesperornithes, a collection of flightless, toothed seabirds from the Cretaceous, and is likely a member of the family Hesperornithidae.
The genus was described by Nesov and Prizemlin in 1991 and is currently classified under the class Reptilia in the Paleobiology Database, despite being a bird.
This animal lived between 83.6 and 66 million years ago along the shores of the ancient Turgai Sea in modern-day Kazakhstan.
